general.title: OMIX Volcano Plot
general.instructions:
Generate enhanced volcano plots from differential expression analysis results.

**To test with example data:** Leave DEG Table CSV blank and click Run.
**To use your own data:** Upload your DEG CSV file below.

categories.name: 📊 Basic Settings
categories.help_text: Essential parameters for volcano plot generation including input data and significance thresholds.

categories.name: 🏷️ Gene Labeling
categories.help_text: Control which genes are labeled on the plot and how they are selected.

categories.name: 📐 Plot Layout
categories.help_text: Customize plot dimensions, axis labels, and visual elements.

categories.name: 🎨 Color Customization
categories.help_text: Set custom colors for each quadrant of the volcano plot.

categories.name: ⚙️ Advanced Options
categories.help_text: Advanced axis capping, limits, and fine-tuning options.

parameters.name: DEG Table CSV
parameters.help_text: CSV file with differential expression results including gene names, p-values, and log2 fold changes. Leave blank to use example data for demo.

parameters.name: P-value Type
parameters.help_text: Choose 'adjusted' for FDR-corrected p-values (adjpval) or 'nominal' for uncorrected p-values (pval).

parameters.name: P-value Threshold
parameters.help_text: Significance threshold for p-values (horizontal line on plot).

parameters.name: Log2 Fold Change Threshold
parameters.help_text: Fold change threshold for significance (vertical lines on plot).

parameters.name: Number of Features to Label
parameters.help_text: Number of top genes to label on the plot.

parameters.name: Choose Feature to Label By
parameters.help_text: Sort genes by p-value or fold change before selecting top N to label.

parameters.name: Label Only Passing Thresholds
parameters.help_text: If true, only label genes that pass both p-value and fold-change thresholds.

parameters.name: Custom Gene List
parameters.help_text: Comma-separated list of additional genes to label (e.g., STAT1, IRF7, MX1). Leave empty for none.

parameters.name: Label Only Custom List
parameters.help_text: If true, only genes in Custom Gene List will be labeled.

parameters.name: Label Box Padding
parameters.help_text: Padding around each label box. Higher values = more space around labels, reducing overlap.

parameters.name: Label Repulsion Force
parameters.help_text: Repulsion force between overlapping labels. Higher values = stronger repulsion (0.5-3 typical range).

parameters.name: Label Max Overlaps
parameters.help_text: Maximum number of overlapping labels allowed. Use lower values to hide crowded labels.

parameters.name: Plot Title
parameters.help_text: Main title for the volcano plot.

parameters.name: Plot Subtitle
parameters.help_text: Optional subtitle for the plot. Leave empty to auto-generate from comparison name.

parameters.name: Plot Title Size
parameters.help_text: Font size for the main plot title.

parameters.name: Axis Title Size
parameters.help_text: Font size for X and Y axis titles (e.g., 'log2 Fold Change', '-log10(p-value)').

parameters.name: Axis Tick Label Size
parameters.help_text: Font size for axis tick labels (the numbers on the axes).

parameters.name: Label Size
parameters.help_text: Font size for gene labels.

parameters.name: Point Size
parameters.help_text: Size of points in the scatter plot.

parameters.name: Image Width (pixels)
parameters.help_text: Width of output image in pixels.

parameters.name: Image Height (pixels)
parameters.help_text: Height of output image in pixels.

parameters.name: Resolution (DPI)
parameters.help_text: Image resolution in dots per inch.

parameters.name: Not Significant Color
parameters.help_text: Color for non-significant points (ordered light to dark).

parameters.name: Fold Change Only Color
parameters.help_text: Color for points with fold change only (ordered light to dark).

parameters.name: Significant Only Color
parameters.help_text: Color for significant points with significance only (ordered light to dark).

parameters.name: Significant + Fold Change Color
parameters.help_text: Color for significant points with fold change (ordered light to dark).

parameters.name: Use Custom Axis Labels
parameters.help_text: Enable custom axis labels defined below.

parameters.name: Custom Significance Label
parameters.help_text: Custom label for significance axis (requires 'Use Custom Axis Labels' enabled).

parameters.name: Custom Log Fold Change Label
parameters.help_text: Custom label for fold change axis (requires 'Use Custom Axis Labels' enabled).

parameters.name: Y-axis Limit
parameters.help_text: Maximum Y-axis value (0 = automatic).

parameters.name: Use Auto Axis Capping
parameters.help_text: Automatically cap axis limits at specified quantile to reduce outlier impact.

parameters.name: Auto Capping Quantile
parameters.help_text: Quantile for auto-capping (0.5-1.0). Higher = less aggressive capping.

parameters.name: Symmetric X-axis
parameters.help_text: Use symmetric X-axis limits when auto-capping is enabled.

parameters.name: Custom X-axis Limits
parameters.help_text: Custom X-axis range (e.g., '5' for -5 to 5, or '-2,4' for -2 to 4). Leave empty for automatic.

parameters.name: X-axis Padding
parameters.help_text: Additional padding for X-axis limits.

parameters.name: Y-axis Padding
parameters.help_text: Additional padding for Y-axis limits.
